text:
olivia_csm: quick ask — can we draft a compact, customer-facing primer for go-live priming + renewal-risk signals focused on caching/batching/streaming? need something single-page to hand to PMs and account owners.
kevin_eng: +1, do you want separate sections for config + run actions? or a short checklist would be better for customers.
maria_cs: checklist pls. customers skim. include when to prefill, when to enable streaming, and what to watch in telemetry.
olivia_csm: agreed. draft outline: 1) preflight checks (connectivity, model pinning) 2) priming steps (prefill, warm pools) 3) runtime knobs (batch size, TTLs) 4) failure modes + mitigation 5) signals for renewal risk and when to escalate. keep examples short.
kevin_eng: putting sample snippets in case they need to push to infra: 
kevin_eng: ```yaml
prefill: true
warm_pool: 2
batch: {max_tokens: 256, max_requests: 8}
streaming: auto
cache_ttl_seconds: 300
```
sam_sre: note — streaming=true reduces perceived latency but increases concurrent connections. add guidance on concurrency limits and graceful fallback to non-streaming.
maria_cs: add a small comms blurb for CSMs: what to tell customer if we request an account priming window. one-liner: "We'll run a brief priming job to reduce cold-start latency and ensure steady throughput during your initial ramp."
olivia_csm: good. also include an ops escalation flow for renewal-risk: thresholds like 3x error rate, 30% drop in success rate on golden prompts, or sustained 2x latency degradation over baseline for >15m.
kevin_eng: suggest we include exact telemetry queries they can paste into Console: 
kevin_eng: ```query
errors_per_minute(service="inference", tenant="{{tenant_id}}")
avg_latency_ms(window=5m, model="{{model}}")
svr_success_rate(prompt_set="golden")
```
maria_cs: Love the golden prompt check. Include a short template for capture: subject line + 3 bullets to collect from customer after priming.
maria_cs: Template: "Priming complete — please run 5 representative flows and note: 1) any unexpected completions 2) average latency 3) errors or timeouts"
sam_sre: add automated hooks: if avg_latency_ms > baseline*2 for 15m -> alert to #eng-oncall and create ticket with tag onboarding:high-latency. Also fallback policy: route to compatible smaller model or increase batch window.
opsbot: Automated note: created k8s job hook sample in repo -> /ops/templates/priming-job.yaml (internal). :white_check_mark:
olivia_csm: for renewal-risk play, recommend cadence: 48h post-priming check, 7-day lookback for regressions, then 1:1 with AM if metrics still bad. escalate to solutions eng if unresolved after 72h.
kevin_eng: add quick troubleshooting checklist (order matters): 1) confirm model pin and quantization 2) check warm pool size 3) enable prefill for heavy prompt prefixes 4) reduce batch.max_requests to lower tail latency 5) disable streaming temporarily to debug concurrency issues.
maria_cs: final bit — feedback capture: short form link we send after priming: "How did the model responses match expectations? (Better/Same/Worse) + short freeform". Capture in ticket.
olivia_csm: I'll stitch this into a one-pager and drop back here for review. tagging @kevin_eng and @sam_sre for tech review. timeline: EOD tomorrow?
kevin_eng: can do review tomorrow morning.
sam_sre: thumbs up. i'll add the alert snippets to runbook repo.
maria_cs: thanks — will prep the customer-facing cover email. :sparkles: 
olivia_csm: awesome, thanks team. sending draft in 2 edits. :party_parrot:
